messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick pulse check  need to lock marketplace listing + joint HW announcement schedule. Target public publish Tue 09:00 PT, embargo Tue 07:00 PT. Who has final assets?

Ethan (Marketplaces): I have marketplace YAML drafts for AWS/GCP. Need final SKU descriptions and max download size from partners. Will hold publish until we get those.

Priya (Marketing): Blog + press draft are at 90%. Waiting on a 1-line partner tagline and logos in SVG. Also need a customer quote for the hero.

Rui (Design): Uploaded banner comps to staging: /assets/marketplace/banners/v3. Prefer dark BG for HW co-branding. Can adapt once logos land.

Dex (SI): SI integration guide is signed off internally. One ask: can we include a sample helm values.yaml snippet in the public docs? If not, we'll keep it in the partner repo.

Sana (Legal): Public docs: helm examples fine as long as no secrets or support SLAs are exposed. Also: partners requested brief SLA sentence; we can include a 20-30 word summary only. Embargo wording: no naming unreleased partners; no claims on compliance (SOC2).

Maya (Partnerships): Good. Two blockers to close: (1) Acme customer quote (2) IceChip cert matrix + final SVGs. If either misses EOD Mon we slide publish to Wed.

Ethan (Marketplaces): FYI publishing window: 2781239000 (staging->prod). infra-bot will run smoke and tag release.

infra-bot: release-scheduler: cutover scheduled 2781239000. Pre-cutover checklist: smoke tests green, promo banners off, CDN warm.

Priya (Marketing): I can shorten the press embargo section per Sana. Will drop redlines in the doc and ping partners for quote.

Rui (Design): Small mobile tweak required on Acme SVG  stroke width looks off at 1x. I'll patch if they don't send corrected asset in 1hr.

Dex (SI): Noted. I'll keep helm snippet in private repo and link from public docs.

Maya (Partnerships): Thanks. Please react with :white_check_mark: when your piece is done. I'll pull together checklist and confirm final publish time. :rocket:
